dedupe_keys.name: cross sector drinking water urban heat and housing indicators

description: This indicator collection covers drinking-water supply, urban heat and housing provision as linked planning domains. Researchers extracted and categorised 280 indicators from peer-reviewed sources and organised them in a relational database. The current Zenodo version 1.2 archives the GitHub source, whose public inventory lists CSV tables, SQL, Access and OpenDocument files plus validation material. Both repositories identify CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Coverage is a literature-derived indicator set, not measurements of a particular utility, neighbourhood or building stock; the country scope of the concepts is broad, but field applicability depends on the originating studies. Definitions and units require checking before using indicators as model outputs or constraints. A reviewer-assessed use is designing multi-sector planning scenarios or comparing water and housing service measures. model-epanet is a related water-system model, but no direct mapping of indicators to its variables is claimed. An older Zenodo version and the current release represent one collection. No database or source archive was downloaded.
